'''Athakam Medtech''' was a major medical technology manufacturer which worked closely with the [[Rhinnal State Medical Academy]] to develop medical tools and equipment. The partnership produced [[microsurgery computer]]s, [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] controllers, and [[hyperbaric medical chamber]]s. Some of its most well known products were the [[Bioscan Unit]]<ref name="EGWT" /> and the [[Med Unit]].<ref name="GFT" />

The company was also the galaxy's biggest supplier of medical supplies. Some of Athakam's experiments went towards development of chemical weapons, but by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] the company had returned to its pacifistic roots, mostly due to the high costs of chemical weapons research, and even secretly supplied the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] with medical supplies for their war effort, despite the company's stated neutrality.
